note: FD.44 / GD.14 (Go handler bases and the FH.14 gorilla handoff). A route handler `h.List` whose base is a local bound from a chain rooted in another local (`h := s.Handlers()`, `s *svc.Svc` a parameter) or a `self.<field>` alias (`h := s.handlers` in a method of `s`) kept base `h`; with two types sharing every method name the repo-unique name fallback binds nothing. microservices-demo's frontend shape: `r.HandleFunc(baseUrl+"/", svc.homeHandler).Methods(http.MethodGet, http.MethodHead)`, `baseUrl` a package var initialised "" and reassigned from os.Getenv; try_emit_gorilla_methods_chain read only string literals, so no ROUTE was minted.
